reactionDistribution.title: How fast are players? Best five-round averages
reactionDistribution.aria: Histogram of best reaction time averages from 8,791 players. Most players fall between 280 and 440 ms, peaking at 340 to 359 ms. The median is 369 ms.
reactionDistribution.caption: 8,791 players, March 8 to October 23, 2026, each counted once with their best result. Bars are 20 ms wide; 218 players between 800 and 1,000 ms are not shown.
